mil6.1.4:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, yadā Bodhisatto dukkarakārikaṃ akāsi, n' etādiso aññatra ārambho ahosi nikkamo kilesayuddhaṃ Maccusenavidhamanaṃ āhārapariggaho dukkarakārikā, evarūpe parakkame kañci assādaṃ alabhitvā tam-eva cittaṃ parihāpetvā evam-avoca: Na kho panāhaṃ imāya kaṭukāya dukkarakārikāya adhigacchāmi uttariṃ manussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ, siyā nu kho añño maggo bodhāyāti. Tato nibbinditvā aññena maggena sabbaññutaṃ patto puna tāya paṭipadāya sāvake anusāsati samādapeti:
mil6.1.4:3.1: Kena nu kho bhante Nāgasena kāraṇena Tathāgato yāya paṭipadāya attanā nibbiṇṇo virattarūpo tattha sāvake anusāsati samādapetīti.
mil6.1.4:4.1: Tadā pi mahārāja etarahi pi sā yeva paṭipadā, taṃ yeva paṭipadaṃ paṭipajjitvā Bodhisatto sabbaññutaṃ patto.
mil6.1.4:4.2: Api ca mahārāja Bodhisatto ativiriyaṃ karonto niravasesato āhāraṃ uparundhi,
mil6.1.4:4.4: so tena dubbalyena nāsakkhi sabbaññutaṃ pāpuṇituṃ, so mattamattaṃ kabaḷinkārāhāraṃ sevanto tāy' eva paṭipadāya nacirass' eva sabbaññutaṃ pāpuṇi.
mil6.1.4:4.5: Sā yeva mahārāja paṭipadā sabbesaṃ tathāgatānaṃ sabbaññutañāṇapaṭilābhāya.
mil6.1.4:5.1: Yathā mahārāja sabbasattānaṃ āhāro upatthambho, āhārūpanissitā sabbe sattā sukhaṃ anubhavanti;
mil6.1.4:5.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja sā yeva paṭipadā sabbesaṃ tathāgatānaṃ sabbaññutañāṇapaṭilābhāya. N' eso mahārāja doso ārambhassa, na nikkamassa, na kilesayuddhassa, yena Tathāgato tasmiṃ samaye na pāpuṇi sabbaññutañāṇaṃ, atha kho āhārūparodhass' ev' eso doso, sadā paṭiyattā yeva sā paṭipadā.
mil6.1.4:6.1: Yathā mahārāja puriso addhānaṃ ativegena gaccheyya, tena so pakkhahato vā bhaveyya pīṭhasappī vā asañcaro paṭhavitale,
mil6.1.4:6.2: api nu kho mahārāja mahāpaṭhaviyā doso atthi yena so puriso pakkhahato ahosīti. -
mil6.1.4:6.4: sadā paṭiyattā bhante mahāpaṭhavī, kuto tassā doso,
mil6.1.4:6.5: vāyāmass' ev' eso doso yena so puriso pakkhahato ahosīti.-Evam-
mil6.1.4:6.6: eva kho mahārāja n' eso doso ārambhassa, na nikkamassa, na kilesayuddhassa yena Tathāgato tasmiṃ samaye na pāpuṇi sabbaññutañāṇaṃ, atha kho āhārūparodhass' ev' eso doso, sadā paṭiyattā yeva sā paṭipadā.
mil6.1.4:7.1: Yathā vā pana mahārāja puriso kiliṭṭhaṃ sāṭakaṃ nivāseyya, na so taṃ dhovāpeyya, n' eso doso udakassa, sadā paṭiyattaṃ udakaṃ,
mil6.1.4:7.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja n'eso doso ārambhassa, na nikkamassa, na kilesayuddhassa, yena Tathāgato tasmiṃ samaye na pāpuṇi sabbaññutañāṇaṃ, atha kho āhārūparodhass' ev' eso doso, sadā paṭiyattā yeva sā paṭipadā. Tasmā Tathāgato tāy' eva paṭipadāya sāvake anusāsati samādapeti. Evaṃ kho mahārāja sadā paṭiyattā anavajjā sā paṭipadā ti. -
mil6.1.4:7.4: Sādhu bhante Nāgasena, evam-etaṃ, tathā sampaṭicchāmīti.
